title: Finding your way before GPS
h1: Finding your way before GPS: clocks, the Moon, the compass, and where each method runs out
dek: How navigators solved direction and position before satellites, what the records say about accuracy, and why a map, a compass and a plan still matter.
description: A source-checked history of longitude, sextants, the compass and Polaris, with plain limits on each method and current agency advice on declination and travel.
recheck: If any listed source changes; when Marcy's chapters on route-finding and the Board of Longitude's papers are read directly; and if an official or museum source for sun and shadow direction-finding is found.

safety_review.scope: Not a gated slate item (taxonomy gate: false). No instructions, quantities or procedures are given. Editorial read-through still required.

source_use.hist-field-rmg-why-longitude: The 1707 Scilly disaster, the lobbying origin of the 1714 Act, the reward, earlier schemes, Galileo's Jupiter proposal and Newton's objection.
source_use.hist-field-rmg-harrison: Harrison's timekeepers, the Lisbon and Barbados trials, the Board's 1765 finding, the dispute, cost and slow roll-out.
source_use.hist-field-rmg-lunar: Lunar distances, Mayer and Bradley, the first marine sextant, Maskelyne's 1761 trial figures, the Nautical Almanac and its computers, and the persistence of dead reckoning.
source_use.hist-field-si-sextant: Smithsonian record of a Ramsden sextant and the meaning of its 60-degree scale; chronometer description.
source_use.hist-field-usgs-declination: Declination varies with place and time; map collar information; compass can point south at high latitudes.
source_use.hist-field-usgs-north-arrows: The three north arrows on USGS topographic maps and that very old maps may lack them.
source_use.hist-field-noaa-declination: Declination definition, sign convention, true bearing = magnetic + declination, and that a compass points along the local field.
source_use.hist-field-nasa-north-star: Polaris as a reliable direction of north in the Northern Hemisphere; its limits; no south pole star.
source_use.hist-field-nws-winter-before: Compass and road maps in a winter kit; do not depend on phones; tell someone your route.
source_use.loc-prairie-traveler: Library of Congress digitized handbook; title page, preface and contents only.
